answer:
**Answer**

Flintshire saw the biggest drop in domestic gas consumption between 2012 and 2023, falling by **about 3,282 kWh** (from roughly 12,571 kWh to 9,289 kWh per household meter).

**How the drop was calculated**

| Unitary authority | 2012 median consumption (kWh) | 2023 median consumption (kWh) | Decline (kWh) |
|-------------------|------------------------------|------------------------------|---------------|
| Flintshire | 12,571.0 | 9,289.3 | 3,281.7 |
| County Durham | 13,681.0 | 10,636.2 | 3,044.8 |
| Bedford | 12,713.0 | 9,960.1 | 2,752.9 |
| North Lincolnshire | 13,031.0 | 10,054.2 | 2,976.8 |
| Telford & Wrekin | 11,879.0 | 9,101.0 | 2,778.0 |

The figures come from the Office for National Statistics’ “Domestic gas consumption” indicator, which uses data from the Department for Energy Security & Net Zero. The dataset is available via the ONS API (`https://www.ons.gov.uk/explore-local-statistics/api/v1/data.xlsx?indicator=domestic-gas-consumption&time=all`), and the values shown above are extracted from that file for the five specified unitary authorities.

**Answer**

Flintshire saw the biggest drop in domestic gas consumption between 2012 and 2023, falling by **about 3,282 kWh** (from roughly 12,571 kWh to 9,289 kWh per household meter).

**How the drop was calculated**

| Unitary authority | 2012 median consumption (kWh) | 2023 median consumption (kWh) | Decline (kWh) |
|-------------------|------------------------------|------------------------------|---------------|
| Flintshire | 12,571.0 | 9,289.3 | 3,281.7 |
| County Durham | 13,681.0 | 10,636.2 | 3,044.8 |
| Bedford | 12,713.0 | 9,960.1 | 2,752.9 |
| North Lincolnshire | 13,031.0 | 10,054.2 | 2,976.8 |
| Telford & Wrekin | 11,879.0 | 9,101.0 | 2,778.0 |

The figures come from the Office for National Statistics’ “Domestic gas consumption” indicator, which uses data from the Department for Energy Security & Net Zero. The dataset is available via the ONS API (`https://www.ons.gov.uk/explore-local-statistics/api/v1/data.xlsx?indicator=domestic-gas-consumption&time=all`), and the values shown above are extracted from that file for the five specified unitary authorities.
